compiled_state.title: reconcile-bridge-canary.yml: hourly GHA workflow that alerts on staleness
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: GREEN: create .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml (hourly cron + workflow_dispatch). Checks last successful run of reconcile-bridge.yml via GitHub API; if last success is older than HEARTBEAT_ALERT_WINDOW_HOURS (default 2h), creates or updates a GitHub Issue labeled heartbeat-alert. Closes the alert issue when reconciler recovers. Supports dry_run workflow_dispatch input for testing without issue side effects. Document the workflow in operator runbook comment on story 7004.
